name: UNSW Equity Award (current students)
summary: One-year award for current UNSW undergraduate or postgraduate coursework students in socioeconomic hardship.
who: Currently studying a UNSW eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree
Australian citizen, permanent resident or NZ citizen
how: Current students submit an Equity Scholarships (ES) application through UAC
catches: February 2027 round for current, postgraduate and honours students: ES by 29 Jan 2027

source.label: UNSW Scholarships: UNSW Equity Scholarships for 2027

evidence.quote: Supports current students at UNSW who may be experiencing hardship due to their socioeconomic circumstances.
